title: Task-disjoint next-control prediction from verified Kimi K3 traces
hypothesis: Laya can learn task-conditioned next-control decisions from successful frontier-agent traces and expose uncertainty useful for selective execution.

included: task-disjoint generalization within one coding harness

dataset.unit: one cumulative trajectory prefix ending in one target assistant turn
preflight_requirements: enumerate assistant target tool names and multiplicities
confirm every row ends at target_message_index
quantify missing or redacted tool observations and arguments
deduplicate exact rendered states by trajectory group

state_fields: task text from first user message
input.truncation: retain task and most recent observable history

primary_questions.name: call_<tool_family>
primary_questions.semantics: binary membership in the target assistant turn's tool-call set

target.parallel_calls: preserved as a multi-label family set
target.duplicate_calls_same_family: collapsed for the primary target and reported separately
target.teacher_probabilities: hard one-hot distributions derived from observable target tool calls
target.abstention: post-hoc threshold on calibrated probability of the predicted complete decision bundle; no synthetic escalation labels

splits.train: source train trajectories excluding deterministic calibration groups
splits.calibration: 20% of source train trajectories by sha256(group_key + seed)
splits.test: source val trajectories, untouched until model/checkpoint/threshold freeze

subsets.smoke: 100 train trajectories capped at 500 decision rows; one optimizer step then at most 100 updates; no test scoring
subsets.main: all eligible source train trajectories after calibration holdout; test is all eligible source val trajectories

model.architecture: ModernBERT-large encoder plus Laya decision head
model.training_regime: full encoder and decision-head fine-tuning using upstream RLCD plus soft cross-entropy
model.checkpoint_selection: lowest calibration NLL, tie-broken by bundle exact match
model.temperature_fitting: held-out calibration only; remove stale option-count temperatures or fit the same buckets

metrics.primary: complete decision-bundle exact match on task-disjoint test
secondary: top-k accuracy where a choice has more than two options
selective: coverage at calibration-frozen 80% and 90% target accuracy

failure_criteria: bundle gain 95% CI upper bound is below +5 points
full-state model does not beat both task-only and history-only ablations
no calibration-frozen threshold reaches 80% accuracy at 50% coverage
ECE exceeds 0.20 after held-out temperature fitting
fewer than minimum eligible rows remain after preflight
one-step full-model smoke exceeds 11.5 GiB or the projected main run exceeds 24 hours
invalidating_conditions: target assistant message or reasoning in model state
execution_gates: resolve every UNRESOLVED field and write a frozen protocol copy
pass dataset schema and leakage preflight
freeze splits, tool-family map, and checksums
train and freeze baselines before official test scoring

experiment_002.trigger: Experiment 001 fails broad pilot criteria without invalidation
experiment_002.design: Repeat the same protocol on one coherent domain, selected from observed data coverage; design/frontend/Three.js is eligible only after obtaining verified domain traces.
experiment_002.comparison: pre-register whether narrowing improves accuracy, calibration, and selective coverage under the same trajectory-level split discipline
